text:
This photo shows the leftovers after a meal, so I'm estimating only what remains.

- The plate on the left has a sauce smear, roughly 10 g, about 15 kcal.
- The bowl on the right has a few residual bits, about 5 g, about 5 kcal.
- The center plate has a small tomato piece, a bit of lettuce and some crumbs, about 5 g, about 5 kcal.
- The fork-like brown item on the tray is probably a piece of food, about 3 g, about 5 kcal.

The juice in the glass and the bottle residue are drinks rather than plate food, so I left them out of the total. The glass of juice would add about 100 kcal (about 240 g) if counted.

The total for the leftover food is about 30 kcal and about 23 g.
